instruction: A candid wedding photograph, medium shot at eye-level with a shallow depth of field. In an elegant indoor hotel lobby with potted plants and grey sofas in the background, the woman with curly hair in a white one-shoulder dress (R1) stands on the left, looking warmly at the woman in a white pantsuit (R2) who stands on the right. The woman in a white dress (R1) places her left hand gently on the shoulder of the woman in a white pantsuit (R2), who holds a bouquet of pink peonies and looks down with a soft smile. Soft, natural light fills the space, creating a warm and serene atmosphere with neutral tones.
